errors.trigger: Stage name and failure context are missing
errors.diagnosis: There is not enough information to diagnose a failing stage
errors.rescue_action: Ask for the failing stage or error output
errors.user_message: Provide a failing stage name or error output before running trace.

errors.trigger: No failing stage, run object, or last_error is available
errors.diagnosis: Trace requires a real failure to diagnose
errors.rescue_action: Halt and show the missing prerequisite
errors.user_message: No failing stage or error state was found. Run the failing skill first.

errors.trigger: Manifest or errors metadata path is unsafe or invalid
errors.diagnosis: Trace cannot safely load rescue metadata
errors.rescue_action: Reject unsafe paths and ask to repair skills/manifest.json or errors.json
errors.user_message: Error metadata is invalid or unsafe. Repair manifest/errors metadata before tracing.

errors.trigger: Error not reproducible or fix does not resolve root cause
errors.diagnosis: The error cannot be reproduced in a clean environment or the applied fix did not resolve it
errors.rescue_action: Log full context, suggest manual diagnosis, or route to /fab-signal
errors.user_message: Error not reproducible or fix did not resolve it. Manual diagnosis recommended.

errors.trigger: Candidate run object fails schema validation
errors.diagnosis: Trace update would corrupt run state
errors.rescue_action: Show validator output and do not replace fabrica.run.json
errors.user_message: The candidate run state failed validation. No state was written.
